note: Region proposed by a human standing in it and confirmed by `bench:world qualify`. Every number is measured, not assumed - re-check with `npm run bench:world -- verify`. Targets sit ONE BLOCK ABOVE their column's measured surface rather than replacing it: replacing the grass block removes the very marker the surface profile is measured from. The target is emerald_block, NOT coal_ore, and that is load-bearing: findBlocks queries the client's world model with no line-of-sight, so it returns blocks encased in solid stone. Measured here: 3219 natural coal_ore within 64 blocks of the start, every one of them buried. A coal_ore target is therefore found at the origin without the bot moving, and the benchmark would score perception rather than search. emerald_block does not occur in worldgen at all, so a hit is unambiguously the block we placed.
